jobs.description: The SOS Children's Villages worldwide Hermann-Gmeiner-Fonds Deutschland e.V. is an independent, non-denominational children's rights organization. With almost 3,000 programs in over 130 countries, the organization offers help to children, young people and families in need through education, medical care and family strengthening. The focus is on strengthening the family, sustainability, children's rights and cultural sensitivity.   To support our Scholarships & Educational Development team in our Munich office, we are looking for a (Junior) Program Manager - Scholar Support & Quality (m/f/d) on a full time basis. Your tasks As (Junior) Program Manager - Scholar Support & Quality, take operational ownership of scholar support, program quality, and MEAL within the Global Scholarship Program (GSP). Coordinate data collection, analysis and reporting and ensure findings are translated into concrete program improvements. Coordinate impact measurement approaches, including SROI, and lead the preparation of the GSP annual report. Provide administrative support to the team Scholar Support & Documentation: Manage and coordinate the scholar support process throughout their journey. Maintain and update scholar information as well as all relevant documents (communications, reports, transcripts) in appropriate databases and tools. Schedule check-ins & respond promptly to general inquiries from students and stakeholders. Serve as the primary contact for scholar inquiries on YouthLinks Community (an internal communication platform), by coordinating, developing, and posting relevant information, guidance, and support materials for scholars. Prepare reports as required        Your profile You have successfully completed studies in social work, psychology, youth development, social sciences, education, international development, public policy or a related field. You bring initial relevant professional experience in one or more areas such as student or youth support, program quality, monitoring and evaluation. Skills in MHPSS are an advantage. You are highly organized and approach routine and recurring tasks with diligence and understand their importance for effective scholar support, monitoring and program management. You are proactive and bring forward innovative ideas for improvements. You are a team player with a positive attitude, hands-on-mentality and get things done. You are flexible in navigating a complex and fast changing environment and have the ability to prioritize effectively when faced with multiple requests. You have effective communication skills with excellent command of English. Another foreign language such as Spanish, Portuguese, German, Arabic or French is an advantage. You have very good skills in MS-Office, Adobe & Canva. Additional computer skills are a plus. At SOS Children's Villages Worldwide, we actively stand against racism and discrimination, and we welcome applications from people regardless of their ethnic, national, or social background, gender, disability, age, or sexual orientation. If you are excited about this challenging role, we look forward to receiving your application soon! SOS-Kinderdörfer weltweit  Ridlerstr. 55 80339 München
